questions.stem: What is the term used for plants that have no branches but a tall trunk with leaves at the top?

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of an animal that floats on the surface of water?
questions.solution: Swan is an example of an animal that floats on the surface of water because its body structure and feathers help it stay buoyant. Frogs can float but are not primarily associated with floating on the surface, fish are fully aquatic and do not float on the surface, and wild buffalo are not adapted to float on water. To store food in the form of starch
questions.solution: The main function of roots in plants is to provide support and absorb moisture and minerals from the soil, which is the correct option. Roots do not produce flowers or fruits, as those are typically produced by other parts of the plant. Photosynthesis is carried out by leaves, not roots, and while some roots may store food, this is not their primary role.
